notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. 
Phase changes: 550 K, $\alpha - \beta$ transition point of La; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.087$ kcal/mol.
1134 K, $\beta - \gamma$ transition point of La; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.746$ kcal/mol.
1193 K, melting point of La; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.481$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2500 K: $Cp^{0} = 8.859 + 0.042 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.579 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0} - H_{298}^{0} = 8.859 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.021 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 0.579 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 2.837$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-550 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 17.688 - 1.897 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.189 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 11.750 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ $\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 17.688 + 1.897 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.189 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 5.875 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 31.802 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 550-1134 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 16.708 + 0.369 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 1.891 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 100.550 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ $\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 16.708 - 0.369 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 1.891 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 50.275 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 16.805 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 1134-1193 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 19.624 - 4.787 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.139 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 23.750 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ $\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 19.624 + 4.787 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.139 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 11.875 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 53.625 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 1193-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 16.622 - 3.512 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.139 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 23.750 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ $\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 16.622 + 3.512 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.139 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 11.875 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 42.076 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Schumm (104). Other data are those estimated by Mills (80).
